message.content:
An editorial illustration shows two men on a single orange bicycle against a backdrop of white clouds. The man in front, wearing a white button-down shirt and dark pants, holds the handlebars. He faces forward and smiles. The man seated behind him on the rear rack wears a light tan short-sleeved shirt, matching pants, and a black cap. He looks back over his shoulder, holding his left hand up with his palm facing outward. His right hand grips the front man’s waist.

The bicycle is an orange-framed model with thin black tires, metal spokes, and a brown seat. Text in large black letters to the left reads "YANG LALU BIAR BERLALU," followed by a paragraph of smaller Indonesian text. Above, white text reads "ISU RADIKALISME SEPUTAR SELEKSI PEMIMPIN KPK" and "ATURAN BATU BARA YANG MENYENGAT JONAN." The word "TEMPO" is centered in large white letters. A barcode, date "1-7 JULI 2019," and price "RP 45.000" are in the bottom right corner. A solid red border runs along the left edge.
